demos.description: - flex doesn't work together with width.

demos.name: ColumnSizingGrid
demos.description: To restrict resizing a column above a certain width set the maxWidth property in GridColDef.

demos.name: ColumnAutosizing
demos.description: - columns: An array of column field names to autosize.

demos.name: ColumnAutosizingAsync
demos.description: Use API method apiRef.current.autosizeColumns(autosizeOptions) to adjust the column size programmatically.

demos.name: ColumnAutosizingVirtualized
demos.description: The time to complete the autosizing operation exponentially depends on the number of virtualized columns.

demos.name: ColumnAutosizingDynamicRowHeight
demos.section: Autosizing › Autosizing with dynamic row height
demos.description: Column autosizing is compatible with the Dynamic row height feature.

demos.name: ColumnAutosizingHeaderFilters
demos.description: To include the header filter content when autosizing columns, pass the includeHeaderFilters to the autosizeOptions.

demos.name: ColumnAutosizingGroupedRows
demos.description: When using row grouping you can utilize the autosizeColumns method to adjust the column width of the expanded rows dynamically.
